decisive_items: acute bilateral knee swelling and pain
response.rationale: Acute bilateral swelling after viscosupplementation with elevated synovial WBC but negative Gram stain/cultures favors pseudoseptic arthritis (inflammatory reaction to Synvisc) over septic arthritis (excluded by negative cultures) or reactive arthritis (typically post-enteric/urogenital, not injection-related).

rejected.why: Negative Gram stain and cultures on both knees make septic arthritis very unlikely despite elevated synovial WBC.
Symptom onset 12 hours after injection and lack of antecedent infection make reactive arthritis less specific than a local reaction to the injected hyaluronan.
